no.name: Politicians forbidden to show up on parties

description: A popular journalist, known for his tough interviews with politicians regardless of their political affiliation, has organised a birthday party. He invited prominent members from parties across the political spectrum. Photos from the event have gone viral on the internet and unfortunately, it turns out that some of our voters consider partying with the opposition as a betrayal.

options.description: This is unacceptable! Condemn them publicly.
It's normal to have private relations with the people of the same profession!
We should forbid our party members to attend such events.
